mapper.sql: m.*, r.roomname, r.roomnum, r.location, e.employeename AS reservationistname
FROM meeting AS m LEFT JOIN meetingroom AS r ON m.roomid = r.roomid LEFT JOIN employee AS e ON m.reservationistid = e.employeeid
mapper.select:
SELECT
m.meetingname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{meetingname}, '%')
AND m.status = #{status}
ORDER BY m.starttime DESC

SELECT
WHERE m.reservationistid = #{employeeid} AND m.status = 0
AND m.meetingname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{meetingname}, '%')
ORDER BY m.starttime DESC

SELECT , mp.status AS signstatus, mp.checkintime
JOIN meetingparticipants AS mp ON mp.meetingid = m.meetingid AND mp.employeeid = #{employeeid} WHERE m.status = 0
AND m.meetingname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{meetingname}, '%')
ORDER BY m.starttime DESC

SELECT
WHERE m.status = 1 AND (m.reservationistid = #{employeeid} OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM meetingparticipants AS mp WHERE mp.meetingid = m.meetingid AND mp.employeeid = #{employeeid}))
AND m.meetingname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{meetingname}, '%')
ORDER BY m.canceledtime DESC

SELECT m.meetingname, r.roomname, m.starttime, m.endtime, m.roomid, m.meetingid FROM meeting AS m JOIN meetingparticipants AS mp ON mp.meetingid = m.meetingid AND mp.employeeid = #{employeeid} LEFT JOIN meetingroom AS r ON m.roomid = r.roomid WHERE m.status = 0 AND m.endtime >= NOW() AND m.starttime < DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
AND m.meetingname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{meetingname}, '%')
ORDER BY m.starttime
